about: Founder-owned fixed lines in Indian languages (audit of 5 Nov 2026, G4): every sentence a caller hears, or a practice caller says, that we wrote rather than the client or a model. Words a check LISTENS for (the do-not-call phrases among them) are in call_words.json. Moved here from code unchanged, so the founder can correct them without a code change. Each entry: use (English, what it is for), review (needs_native_review or native_reviewed), reviewed_by, by_language (live: what the code reads) and, where present, drafts (machine-drafted lines that are NOT used; the founder approves one by moving it into by_language). A spoken line is written wholly in the language's own letters (D-861). Code never invents a line for a language missing here: it says so, skips the step, or uses English only where that is safe, as each consumer documents.

handover.use: What the caller hears while a handover to a person is placed (the engine's hand-over line). Written in the language's own letters (D-745): a line in Latin letters is read as English, so the Telugu and Hindi drafts are NOT used, and those callers hear the English line until a line in their own letters is written here.

still_there.use: 'Can you see it?': what an agent whose callers follow along on a screen asks after a silence (Give callers time, D-907). The Telugu line is the founder's (27 Oct 2026). The drafts were never reviewed by a native speaker and are NOT used: until a line is written here, the platform's own 'are you still there?' is said in the caller's language.

on_the_line.use: 'Are you still on the line?': what an agent asks after the caller goes quiet (the voice platform's question, voice.nudgePhrase) when the agent speaks one language and neither it nor its account wrote its own question. The Telugu line is the founder's (6 Nov 2026), given in Latin letters as 'line lo unnara andi?' and written here in Telugu letters; he is to confirm the spelling. A language with no line keeps the platform's own 'are you still there?' in the caller's language.

privacy_notice.template.use: The short notice itself, Markdown, per notice language. Blanks: {business}, {contact}, {days}, {items}, {retention}.

by_language.en:
# {business}: your information when you call us

{business} is responsible for the information collected on our calls. Our calling and AI
assistant are run for us by Calevate, which uses this information only on our instructions.

Calls to and from us may be handled by an AI voice assistant, and every call is recorded.
If you ask, the assistant always tells you that it is an AI and that the call is recorded.

## What we collect

{items}

## Why

To answer your enquiry, to do what you ask us to on the call, and to keep a record of what
was agreed.

## How long we keep it

{retention}

## Your rights

You can ask for a copy of what we hold about you, ask us to correct or erase it, name
someone to act for you, or make a complaint. We answer within {days} days. To stop our calls,
you can also tell the assistant on the call.

To ask: {contact}

If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of
India.
by_language.te:
# {business}: మీరు మాకు కాల్ చేసినప్పుడు మీ సమాచారం

మా కాల్స్‌లో సేకరించే సమాచారానికి {business} బాధ్యత వహిస్తుంది. మా కాలింగ్ మరియు AI
సహాయకుడిని మా తరఫున Calevate నడుపుతుంది; అది ఈ సమాచారాన్ని మా సూచనల మేరకు మాత్రమే
ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

మా కాల్స్‌ను AI వాయిస్ సహాయకుడు చేయవచ్చు లేదా స్వీకరించవచ్చు, మరియు ప్రతి కాల్ రికార్డ్
అవుతుంది. మీరు అడిగితే, తాను AI అని, కాల్ రికార్డ్ అవుతోందని సహాయకుడు ఎప్పుడూ చెబుతుంది.

## మేము సేకరించేవి

{items}

## ఎందుకు

మీ ప్రశ్నకు జవాబు ఇవ్వడానికి, కాల్‌లో మీరు అడిగినది చేయడానికి, ఏమి అంగీకరించామో దాని
రికార్డు ఉంచడానికి.

## ఎంత కాలం ఉంచుతాము

{retention}

## మీ హక్కులు

మా దగ్గర ఉన్న మీ సమాచారం యొక్క ప్రతిని అడగవచ్చు, దాన్ని సరిచేయమని లేదా తొలగించమని
అడగవచ్చు, మీ తరఫున వ్యవహరించడానికి మరొకరిని నియమించవచ్చు, లేదా ఫిర్యాదు చేయవచ్చు. మేము
{days} రోజుల్లోపు జవాబు ఇస్తాము. మా కాల్స్ ఆపమని కాల్‌లోనే సహాయకుడికి కూడా చెప్పవచ్చు.

అడగడానికి: {contact}

మా జవాబుతో మీకు సంతృప్తి లేకపోతే, డేటా ప్రొటెక్షన్ బోర్డ్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా (Data Protection
Board of India) కు ఫిర్యాదు చేయవచ్చు.
by_language.hi:
# {business}: जब आप हमें कॉल करते हैं, तब आपकी जानकारी

हमारी कॉल पर इकट्ठा की गई जानकारी के लिए {business} ज़िम्मेदार है। हमारी कॉलिंग और AI सहायक
हमारी ओर से Calevate चलाता है, जो यह जानकारी केवल हमारे निर्देशों पर इस्तेमाल करता है।

हमारी कॉल AI वॉइस सहायक कर सकता है या उठा सकता है, और हर कॉल रिकॉर्ड होती है। आप पूछें तो
सहायक हमेशा बताएगा कि वह AI है और कॉल रिकॉर्ड हो रही है।

## हम क्या इकट्ठा करते हैं

{items}

## क्यों

आपके सवाल का जवाब देने, कॉल पर आपने जो माँगा वह करने, और जो तय हुआ उसका रिकॉर्ड रखने के लिए।

## कितने समय तक रखते हैं

{retention}

## आपके अधिकार

आप हमारे पास रखी अपनी जानकारी की कॉपी माँग सकते हैं, उसे सुधारने या मिटाने के लिए कह सकते
हैं, अपनी ओर से किसी और को नामित कर सकते हैं, या शिकायत कर सकते हैं। हम {days} दिनों के भीतर
जवाब देंगे। हमारी कॉल बंद करवाने के लिए आप कॉल पर ही सहायक से भी कह सकते हैं।

पूछने के लिए: {contact}

अगर आप हमारे जवाब से संतुष्ट नहीं हैं, तो आप भारत के डेटा संरक्षण बोर्ड (Data Protection
Board of India) में शिकायत कर सकते हैं।

by_language.hi-IN: मुझे किसी इंसान से बात करनी है।
by_language.en-IN: I want to speak to a person.
by_language.kn-IN: ಒಬ್ಬ ಮನುಷ್ಯರ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಬೇಕು, connect ಮಾಡಿ.
by_language.ml-IN: എനിക്ക് ഒരു ആളോട് സംസാരിക്കണം, connect ചെയ്യൂ.
by_language.mr-IN: मला एखाद्या माणसाशी बोलायचं आहे, connect करा.

practice.business.use: Practice caller: asks what the business has and a price (only for a business judged to sell and quote prices).

by_language.te-IN: మీ దగ్గర ఏం ఏం దొరుకుతాయి? Price ఎంత అండి?
by_language.hi-IN: आपके यहाँ क्या-क्या मिलता है? Price कितना है?
by_language.en-IN: What do you have, and how much does it cost?

practice.not_interested.use: Practice caller for an agent that places calls: not interested.

practice.vague_answer.use: Practice caller 'Answers vaguely', two turns, for a business judged to take orders. What a good agent does: Asks one short question to pin down what they meant, then waits. Never asks it twice, never answers for the caller.

practice.low_interest.use: Practice caller 'Has little interest', two turns, for a business judged to take orders. What a good agent does: Makes one short offer and, if the caller stays lukewarm, thanks them and closes politely. Does not press with more questions.

practice.price_in_words.use: Practice caller 'Asks a price and a quantity', two turns, for a business judged to take orders. What a good agent does: Says the price and the quantity in words as a shop says them, never with a rupee sign or digits, in everyday spoken words, and asks at most one question.

en-IN: How much is a kilo of whole chilli?
Okay, can I get two kilos?
hi-IN: साबुत मिर्च एक किलो कितने की है?

practice.goes_quiet.use: Practice caller 'Goes quiet', two turns, for a business judged to take orders. What a good agent does: Checks once, briefly, whether the caller is still there or wants anything, then waits. Does not fill the silence with several questions.

practice.neutral_vague.use: A practice caller's vague second turn for a business not judged to take orders. Only English is written; a language without a line runs no such caller, and the practice run says it was not tested in that language.

practice.neutral_price.use: A practice caller asking a price, two turns, for a business judged to quote prices but not to take orders. Only English is written; same rule as practice.neutral_vague.

en-IN: Okay. Is that the full amount?

practice.neutral_ask.use: A practice caller's opening question when the business's copy names none. Only English is written; same rule as practice.neutral_vague.

by_language.en-IN: What can you help me with?

introduction_salutation.use: The salutation said before the agent introduces itself as an AI assistant (D-865), per language code, only for the languages whose AI sentence is an introduction. Changing it changes every live agent's greeting.
